in_marathi.name: Durgeshwari
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Fortress
in_marathi.long_meaning: Durgeshwari हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Durgeshwari is a Sanskrit name that means 'Goddess of the Fortress'. She is a powerful Hindu goddess revered for her strength and protection. Durgeshwari is often depicted holding a trident, a weapon symbolizing power, and a lotus flower, representing purity and creation.
